raw_response: In late 2023, Bank of America reported achieving 170 basis points of operating leverage for the full year, attributing this to good expense discipline and a reduction in headcount and expenses every quarter. U.S. Bancorp indicated that by the end of the fourth quarter of 2023, it would be on a run rate recognizing $900 million in savings, which would support flat expenses between 2023 and 2024 and contribute to positive operating leverage in 2024. Barclays stated its commitment to delivering aggregate positive operating leverage in the following year (2024), expressing confidence based on ongoing investments and platform efficiencies.
